segments.name: air transportation services
segments.description: Operates scheduled passenger airline service across the United States, the Caribbean, Latin America, Canada and Europe for leisure and business travelers.
segments.evidence: JetBlue has one reportable operating segment, air transportation services.

revenueModel.text: Passengers pay fares and fees for air travel, ancillary upgrades such as EvenMore and Mint, and vacation packages booked through Paisly.
revenueModel.evidence: All JetBlue fares include a free carry-on bag, free seatback entertainment, free high-speed Wi-Fi, free snacks, and free non-alcoholic beverages.
